name: Nord Electro 7
description: Nord Electro 7 stage keyboard (61 and 73 HP): every control of its manual's MIDI controller list, its NRPNs among them.

sources.title: Nord Electro 7 61 User Manual, OS v1.2x, Edition E
sources.notes: MIDI controller list (pages 49, 50 of the PDF) read by tools/profiles/nord/read-nord-cc.mjs from Nord Electro 7 61 User Manual v1.2X-Edition-E.pdf (sha256 869fcb2d5153ba636f0c7d841ad68e6c9fb1913198fa749cded79c35376c8e6f), https://www.nordkeyboards.com/wt/documents/1024/Nord%20Electro%207%2061%20User%20Manual%20v1.2X-Edition-E.pdf. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/nord/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/nord/synths/, not this file.

Every parameter is a row of the manual's MIDI controller list, with its printed name, sent as the control change or NRPN it prints on the channel variable. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
The list prints controller numbers only: every value is 0 - 127, and a setting chosen from a list (a model, a waveform, an effect type) is a number here, not a choice.
The Electro 7 73 HP's manual (Edition C) prints the same list.
Messages the list gives to two rows, both laid out: NRPN 3:20: Synth FM Amount, Synth FM Spectra Env Amt. CEditor sends either, and follows neither when the instrument sends it.

Rows left out, their number column not one message the builder can send: Organ Preset Select (two controllers (59, 65), the list not saying which does what); Piano Select (3 NRPNs (2:32-34) under one name).
Left out, the pedals, the wheel and bank select: 64 Sustain, 67 Soft Pedal, 66 Sostenuto, 11 Ctrl Pedal (Expression), 4 Swell.

coverage.inboundControllers: the instrument sends these same messages when its panel is used, where its MIDI settings allow
